title: Kandalanu
summary: Last king before Nabopolassar in the Babylonian King List.
description: Last king before Nabopolassar in the Babylonian King List. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "Kassite Synchronisms"
reign.note: End of the Babylonian King List ("to Kandalanu in 627 B.C."). CFAH-5 lists him with 22 years in Dynasty 7 (Royal Canon).
